mapper.select: SELECT A.app_seq , A.class_no , A.sub_class_no , A.locarno_group_id , CASE WHEN LENGTH(A.full_ko) > 500 THEN LEFT(A.full_ko, 500) || '...' ELSE A.full_ko END AS goods_summary_ko , CASE WHEN LENGTH(A.full_en) > 500 THEN LEFT(A.full_en, 500) || '...' ELSE A.full_en END AS goods_summary_en , A.goods_count FROM ( SELECT app_seq , class_no , sub_class_no , locarno_group_id , STRING_AGG(locarno_name_ko, ',' ORDER BY trim(locarno_name_ko) collate "C") AS full_ko , STRING_AGG(locarno_name_en, ',' ORDER BY trim(locarno_name_en) collate "C") AS full_en , MAX(goods_count) AS goods_count , MIN(create_at) AS create_at FROM utb_app_locarno WHERE office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND app_seq = #{appSeq} AND del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY locarno_group_id, app_seq, office_seq, class_no, sub_class_no ) A ORDER BY A.create_at ASC

SELECT class_no , sub_class_no , goods_seq , locarno_group_id , locarno_name_ko , locarno_name_en , goods_count FROM utb_app_locarno WHERE office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND app_seq = #{appSeq} AND locarno_group_id = #{locarnoGroupId} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY locarno_name_ko ASC
